message.content:
**Decision: Buy AAPL — order filled.**

**What the annual report showed (FY2024, ended Sept 28, 2024, filed Nov 1, 2024):**
- Total net sales: $391,035M (up 2% from $383,285M)
- **Net income: $93,736M in FY2024 vs. $96,995M in FY2023** — a ~3.4% decline
- Diluted EPS: $6.08 vs. $6.13
- Operating income: $123,216M vs. $114,301M (up ~7.8%)
- Operating cash flow: $118,254M vs. $110,543M
- Gross margin: 46.2% vs. 44.1%; Services revenue $96,169M, up 13%

The key nuance: the net income decline is not operational. Operating income actually rose 7.8% and gross margin expanded 210 bps; net income fell only because of a **one-time $10.2 billion net income tax charge** related to the European Commission's State Aid Decision (the ECJ reinstated the ruling on Sept 10, 2024), which pushed the effective tax rate from 14.7% to 24.1%. Excluding that charge, earnings would have grown. Cash generation also improved to $118.3B, and the company returned ~$110B to shareholders ($95.0B buybacks + $15.2B dividends).

**News check:** Apple's Q4 FY2024 release (Oct 31, 2024) showed quarterly revenue of $94.9B, up 6% year over year — the strongest growth in several quarters — with the $10.2B tax charge flagged. The live feed showed only routine, mildly positive items (steady iPhone 16 supplier builds into December, analysts holding holiday-quarter estimates unchanged) and no corporate actions, halts, or adverse notices. Shares were drifting slightly lower intraday (~$220.5–222.7) with no news catalyst.

**Order placed:** Buy 44 shares of AAPL at a limit of $222.75; filled at $222.75 for a total of **$9,801.00**. This is within every constraint of the standing mandate: AAPL is an eligible ticker, it is a buy order, the notional is under the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily cap (and the $50,000 cash balance covers it without any transfer out of the account), and the limit was set essentially at the market (last $222.70, ask $222.72), so it is close to the current price. The thesis is that Apple's underlying operating momentum — 7.8% operating income growth, 46.2% gross margin, 13% Services growth, and $118B of operating cash flow — is intact and the reported net income dip to $93,736M from $96,995M is a non-recurring tax item rather than a deterioration in the business.
message.reasoning:
Order filled. Note: 44 × 222.75 = $9,801.00, under $10,000. Total today $9,801 < $20,000. Good.

Summarize.
